1. RE-DRAWN FOR TEACHING FROM P&ID 2407-PE-PID-001 A6 (SHT 1-2) WITH INL 2407-IN-INL-001 R4,
C&E 2407-IN-CE-001 A2, RLB 2407-PE-RLB-001 A3 AND EQL 2407-ME-EQL-001 A1. NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.
2. DESIGN CASE = OTS REFERENCE RUN CASE 3, LHSV 0.30 h⁻¹: H₂ 32.7 NL/min, CO₂ 6.54 NL/min,
ETHANOL 68.2 mL/min (H₂:CO₂:EtOH = 5:1:4 MOLAR), N₂ 0; PT-601 30.18 / PT-608 30.09 barg.
3. AT DESIGN: E-601 ELEMENT 150.0 °C, OUTLET TT-602 127.0 °C (TWO-PHASE); BED TT-603/604/605
4. BALANCE CHECKED BEFORE DRAWING: IN 69.59 g/min (H₂ 2.94 + CO₂ 12.84 + EtOH 53.81) = OUT 69.59
(VENT 14.17 + LIQUID 55.42); C, H, O ELEMENT BALANCES CLOSE TO 0.00 %.
5. THE DOCUMENTS SHOW ONE PLC FOR CONTROL, ALARMS AND TRIPS (INL I/O "SOFT"). EACH FIELD
TRANSMITTER IS DRAWN ONCE; ITS DCS AND SIS FUNCTIONS ARE SEPARATE SYMBOLS ON THE SAME PLC.
HOLD: INDEPENDENT SIS LOGIC SOLVER / SENSORS PER IEC 61511.
6. * BAND-HEATER ZONES E1/E2/E3, TT/TIC-611/612/613, 4 kW PER ZONE AND THE BAND-HEATER TRIP
ARE OTS ASSUMPTIONS, NOT IN THE DOCUMENTS. TIC-604 CASCADE ON TIC-612 SP (NORMALLY MAN): OTS.
7. XV-101/201/301/401 AND THE MFC VALVES ARE DRIVEN BY THE SIS (PLC); WIRING NOT SHOWN.
INTERLOCK SCHEDULE AND COMMON TRIP ACTIONS: SHT 2.
8. PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT VALVE (SHOWN) AND TEST CONNECTION (TYP., NOT SHOWN).
REGULATORS PR-101/102/201/202/203/401/402/404 C/W INLET + OUTLET PG (PG-101…414, NOT SHOWN).
9. E-601 → R-601 → E-602 LINES INSULATED (IH). R-601 TUBE UNDER BAND HEATERS + INSULATION.
10. FT-601 IS IN THE INL AND THE OTS, NOT ON P&ID A6. TT-102 (INL) NOT SHOWN: TBC.
11. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY: 1/2" OD TUBING FOR PROCESS (MIXED GAS 0.45 m/s, ETHANOL 0.016 m/s
AT DESIGN); CHILLED WATER 1" (2.0 m/s); COLD-VENT HEADER HOLD (PSV-601 FIRE CASE 400 kg/h).
12. VALVE NUMBERS PER INL R4; N₂ TRAIN NUMBERS PER P&ID A6. NEW: BV-408 (PT-403 ROOT VALVE).
14. PSV OUTLETS: NO OUTLET ISOLATION IN THE DOCUMENTS (FREE
TO CV). HOLD IF PSVs ARE TO BE REMOVED ON LINE.
15. PSV-302 SET 36 barg (RLB A3) IS BELOW THE NORMAL P-301
DISCHARGE PT-301 55.7 barg AND PAHH-301 62: HOLD.
16. PAL-203/103 AT 27 barg ARE BELOW THE 30 barg PROCESS: TBC.
17. PSV BYPASSES (BV NC + NV) TO BE CAR-SEALED CLOSED: TBC.
18. N₂ LP BLANKET 1.5 barg vs T-301 PSV-301 SET 2 barg: TBC.
19. CK-301 / CK-302 DISSIMILAR TYPES (P&ID A6 NOTE 1).
